# MLQ.ai Blog

> > A blog covering AI/ML tutorials, enterprise AI news, startup funding insights, and practical guides for machine learning, deep learning, and algorithmic trading.

MLQ.ai Blog features technical tutorials on TensorFlow, neural networks, and NLP, alongside weekly AI industry updates covering companies like OpenAI, NVIDIA, Google, and Meta. The site also tracks venture capital funding through MLQ VC and provides practical guides for AI applications in finance, blockchain, and generative AI.

## Key Topics

- TensorFlow
- OpenAI
- NVIDIA
- Neural Networks
- Large Language Models
- Startup Funding & Venture Capital
- MLQ VC
- Midjourney & Generative AI
- Natural Language Processing (NLP)
- Deep Learning
- Algorithmic Trading
- Enterprise AI
- GPT-5 & ChatGPT
- Google Gemini
- Blockchain & Smart Contracts

## AI Industry News & Analysis

- [OpenAI Releases GPT-5, Palantir Beats Earnings, AMD Reports Record Revenue](https://blog.mlq.ai/openai-releases-gpt-5-palantir-beats-earnings-amd-reports-record-revenue): OpenAI GPT-5 launch, Palantir earnings, AMD Q2 revenue & AI market updates
- [Meta releases Llama 3.1: The largest open-source AI model yet](https://blog.mlq.ai/meta-releases-llama-3-1): Meta Llama 3.1 launch with 405B parameters, benchmarks vs GPT-4o
- [HSBC's Quantum Trading Breakthrough, OpenAI–NVIDIA $100B Deal, and Micron's Record Earnings](https://blog.mlq.ai/hsbcs-quantum-trading-breakthrough-openai-nvidia-100b-deal-and-microns-record-earnings): HSBC quantum trading, OpenAI-NVIDIA $100B partnership & Micron earnings
- [Google Releases Gemini 2.5 - This Week in AI](https://blog.mlq.ai/google-releases-gemini-2-5): Weekly AI roundup: Google Gemini 2.5, xAI, NVIDIA & startup funding news
- [Nvidia Beats Q2 Earnings by 62%: Using AI to Analyze the Stock](https://blog.mlq.ai/nvidia-q2-earnings-using-ai-to-analyze-the-stock): Nvidia Q2 earnings analysis with 68% YoY growth using ML-based estimates

## Deep Learning & Neural Networks

- [Introduction to Deep Convolutional GANs (DCGANs)](https://blog.mlq.ai/deep-convolutional-gans-dcgans): DCGAN tutorial covering batch normalization, convolutions & image generation
- [Introduction to Sequences and Time Series Forecasting with TensorFlow](https://blog.mlq.ai/time-series-forecasting-tensorflow): TensorFlow time series forecasting: data prep & sequence modeling basics
- [Introduction to Recommendation Systems with TensorFlow](https://blog.mlq.ai/recommendation-systems-tensorflow): TensorFlow recommendation systems: content-based & collaborative filtering
- [Deep Reinforcement Learning for Trading: Project Overview](https://blog.mlq.ai/deep-reinforcement-learning-trading-project): Build deep RL trading agent with LSTM/CNN for Interactive Brokers deployment

## Natural Language Processing (NLP)

- [AI Agents for Data Visualization with AutoGen](https://blog.mlq.ai/ai-agents-data-visualization-autogen): AutoGen tutorial: build multi-agent AI systems for data visualization
